data_fields.name: illuminator_radius_default
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 when the ability has no radius

best_idea: Give each domain tag (lawful, chaotic, neutral, liminal) a time-of-day modifier read from a per-zone schedule table, so a storm god's hits swing with the hour, and calibrate the liminal (balanced) value so its sum over the cycle is close to the fearless extremes.
decision_why: Gives Frankendom domain tags that change damage by zone clock as data rows, with the liminal value calibrated over the cycle; the AI estimate sign defect (D1), the weapon-alignment mismatch (D2) and the dormant explicit-path liminal (D3) are fixed; the illumination pass is kept only if Frankendom has light sources.
acceptance: A server test asserts that at lawful +25 a lawful hit deals 1.25x base, chaotic 0.75x, neutral 1.0x, liminal with max 25 1.0x, a fearless chaotic unit at +25 1.0x, and that the AI damage estimate for the same slot matches the resolved hit within rounding.
